children: REGENXBIO and the University of Pennsylvania entered into a Settlement Agreement with Sarepta Therapeutics and Catalent to resolve patent litigation tied to AAVrh74-based gene therapies, including Elevidys. Sarepta will pay REGENXBIO $39.0 million within 10 days of the effective date, and all ongoing litigation over the asserted patents will be dismissed with prejudice. The settlement includes a release of current claims and a covenant not to sue for future claims relating to AAVrh74-based products, including Elevidys, under the specified patents. The covenant does not extend to patents covering other aspects of gene therapy products.
: Patent litigation settlement and covenant not to sue
: Resolve litigation and secure freedom to operate on AAVrh74 products
